title: Gate-count recursion across layers
statement: Let $F$ be a layered feedforward circuit over the Boolean alphabet $\bbf_2$ with input type $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$, in which every layer has finitely many nodes, and for each natural number $k \le \mathrm{depth}(F)$ let $g_F(k)$ denote the number of non-input gates lying in layers $1,\dots,k$ (so $g_F(0) = 0$). Then for every $d$ with $d + 1 \le \mathrm{depth}(F)$, \[ g_F(d+1) = g_F(d) + \abs{N_{d+1}}, \] where $\abs{N_{d+1}}$ is the number of nodes in layer $d+1$.
hypotheses_covered: circuit over the Boolean alphabet Fin 2 with input type Fin n
replaced:
$\mathrm{gateCountBefore}\,F\,(d+1)$ equals $\mathrm{gateCountBefore}\,F\,d$ plus the cardinality of
the node set at layer $d+1$.
